status_note: Independently reconstructed (archive decision D133). The registered single scoring pass of the ARMS01 WTA secondary (wta_attempt_002) was reproduced from separate code: membership rebuilt byte-identical, all 24 forecast files plus labels, panel and manifest rehashed identical, every estimate within 1e-18 and every gate interval within 3e-18 (registered tolerances 1e-12 and 1e-14), blend weights and all 55 grid losses identical, same gate verdicts.

acceptance.decision_scope: adopt WTA full_entry as the WTA incumbent rung for the WTA01 2019-2024 cohort; the public-model claim is not supported on WTA (interval includes zero); release the WTA past-only logit blend with the BuildOak WTA adaptation as an attributed research artefact, not the default model; reported separately from ATP and never pooled with it
acceptance.reconstruction_numbers_note: file name kept by the shared reconstruction code; its content is the WTA secondary

registration.wta_section: experiments/ARMS01.design.md 'WTA secondary': same design, own gates, cohort WTA01 2019-2024, never pooled with ATP

endpoint.estimand: match-weighted paired log-loss difference, left minus right, on identical matches; negative favours the left
endpoint.note: Brier and winner accuracy are descriptive companions; log loss is the sole gated endpoint.

cohort.definition: all WTA01 2019-2024 primary targets from experiments/runs/WTA01/attempt_001/primary/run/pipeline/selected/<Y>/hgb/full.csv with primary_target = 1; 244 provisional-identity rows excluded; neutral orientation; retirements retained
cohort.priced_subset: none; the WTA secondary registered no market reference line

arm0.label: full
arm0.role: WTA incumbent at registration; saved WTA01 attempt 001 selected, calibrated HGB forecasts, no refit

arm1.label: full_entry
arm1.role: full plus nine declared model columns, refit on the unchanged trunk (WTA has no tier block)
arm1.any_qualifier_definition: 1 when either side entered as Q, as the registered design text says; the LL signed difference is kept.

buildoak.label: BuildOak XGBoost WTA adaptation
buildoak.adaptation: the accepted WTA 2024 adapter (BUILDOAK_EXTENSION attempt 001) replayed walk-forward: one fit per 30 December boundary (2018-12-30 for 2019 targets through 2022-12-30 for 2023), fit-boundary Elo reference, D-2 releases, native menu and blend-activation rules evaluated at each boundary; the accepted WTA 2024 forecasts reused byte-for-byte
buildoak.reproduction_2024: arms01-wta-2024-reproduction-002 byte-identical to the accepted WTA 2024 run (the -001 attempt was interrupted by a host power loss before any fit and is retained)
buildoak.native_rows: all 12,900 forecasts native; no reason-coded fallback row
buildoak.members: 2019-2023: four members (two global models blended 0.65/0.35 with 800 and 650 trees, a Hard specialist and a level-I specialist with 900 trees each); 2024: six members, adding the recent-era WTA global pair (800 and 650 trees, weight 0.35)
buildoak.structural_break: the recent-era blend activates only when the recent rows reach the frozen 15,000 threshold: 5,624 / 8,330 / 9,637 / 12,234 / 14,828 recent rows for 2019-2023 (inactive), 17,638 for 2024 (active). The 2019-2023 BuildOak forecasts therefore come from a structurally different recipe than the 2024 forecasts; the pooled contrasts mix both regimes.

contrast3_blend.form: blend logit = (1 - w) * logit(Alcaraz) + w * logit(BuildOak)

release.artefact: WTA past-only logit blend of full_entry with the BuildOak WTA adaptation
release.status: attributed research artefact (archive D133); not the default model; the BuildOak component is buildoak/tennis-xgboost-autoresearch at 237d1e7 and stays attributed to its author
release.exposure: the BuildOak recipe was developed by its author with sight of later seasons; the artefact carries that exposure
release.atp: no ATP blend is released (ATP gate 3 failed); the two tours are never pooled

limitations: exposed retrospective comparison of complete systems with different legitimate histories; not an untouched test, prospective evidence or a market claim
registration not blind to 2024 (the 22 September review had screened WTA 2024 blends and the WTA 2024 gap); the frozen six-year design is a mitigation, not a cure
WTA contrast 2 was registered as underpowered (16% power at the 2024 gap); an interval including zero is inconclusive, not parity

the source's WTA level codes are inconsistent: level_context_m means 'coded PM', not 'is a WTA 1000'; W maps to the tour-level flag (15 Finals rows in 2015 train as a, not f); SR (WTA protected ranking) is unflagged; PR occurs only in 2024 and never varies in a training window
eight Grand Slams carry no entry code on any row (996 targets encoded as no flag; declared sensitivity reported)

the BuildOak recent-era blend is active only in 2024, so 2019-2023 BuildOak forecasts come from a structurally different recipe; the 2019-2023 BuildOak forecasts are committed and verified but not independently re-run
the BuildOak recipe was selected by its author on ROC AUC with sight of 2026 data; the WTA01 2019-2024 cohort is exposed development data (the full rung was scored on it before this registration)
intervals condition on saved forecasts; no family-wise adjustment across the three gates (disclosed, not corrected)
the WTA02 2025-2026 window is untouched by this result: no refit, and its rung stays full
no claim beyond the named systems, this cohort and paired log loss
interpretation: Gate 1: adopt full_entry as the WTA incumbent rung for WTA01 2019-2024. Gate 2: not supported (interval includes zero; registered as underpowered). Gate 3: passed; the blend is released as an attributed research artefact, not the default model. Independently reconstructed (archive decision D133). Secondary to ATP; never pooled.
